title: Three O'Clock Lullaby
idea: A man who cannot sleep goes downstairs and is rocked to sleep by his own blinking machines, while the neighbour at the window keeps watch over them both.
rule: Moonlight and lantern light always come from screen-left, the machines' green-and-blue blink always comes from screen-right, and Seth only ever moves or leans toward the right.

motifs.clock tick: Seth's head ticking side to side like the pendulum of the tall clock on the landing; fast and wide awake at the start, a slow drowsy nod at the end of the bridge
motifs.celesta twinkles: the rows of small green and blue rack lights, always screen-right, brighter each time: a glow under the stairs, a stripe through the door, the full rack, a field of stars round him, lights he conducts
motifs.muted trumpet: the moonlit four-pane window at screen-left: empty at first, then Wilson's hat peeking above the sill, then Wilson in full with his lantern, then Wilson's final portrait
motifs.electric hum / fans breathing: Seth's hair and quilt lifting and falling in the fans' warm breeze, as if the room breathes
motifs.hummed Oohs and choir: a close-up hum with soft rounded lips into the lens (Seth in the intro); the closing choir belongs to Wilson's still face at the window
motifs.chorus 'Hum me a lullaby': close, low three-quarter from the rack's side, Seth's face lit green from screen-right, singing into the lens; each return is drowsier and nearer the rack

prop.seth: a faded patchwork quilt worn round his shoulders like a cape; it drags down the stairs, billows in the fan breeze, and at the end he tucks it over the rack
prop.wilson: an old tin oil lantern held up in one white glove, always on his screen-left side

shots.lyric: (clock ticking, celesta alone)
shots.still: High angle looking down from above the top landing of a dark wooden staircase at night, warm sepia ink with halftone shading. Seth stands wide-eyed in grey wool socks with a faded patchwork quilt round his shoulders like a cape. He is beside a tall grandfather clock with a plain round face, two black hands and a brass pendulum. Pale moonlight falls from screen-left in a long rectangle across the floorboards. The staircase drops away to screen-right into darkness, where a faint green glow rises from below.
shots.action: His head ticks left, then right, in exact time with the swinging pendulum, eyes wide awake; on the last tick his head stops tilted toward the green glow at screen-right.
shots.role: sets up clock tick

shots.lyric: (celesta)
shots.still: Eye-level three-quarter view from screen-right of Seth halfway down the dark staircase. He clutches the patchwork quilt under his chin with both hands. A soft green glow from below-right lights his face, and moonlight from screen-left rims his wavy hair. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading, dark banister behind him.
shots.action: The green light on his face blinks softly twice like a twinkle; his eyebrows lift and he leans toward it; he takes one long tiptoe step down to the right.
shots.role: sets up celesta twinkles

shots.lyric: Ooh... ooh...
shots.still: Close, straight-on, eye level: Seth's face in the dark stairwell with the quilt's patchwork edge at his chin. His lips are softly rounded in a hum and his eyelids are half-lowered. Green light glows on his right cheek from screen-right, and moonlight touches his left cheek from screen-left. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: Hums with rounded lips, chest rising and falling slowly; on the second hum he looks straight into the lens and his head sways once toward screen-right.
shots.role: sets up hummed Oohs

shots.lyric: It's three o'clock, the house is still,
shots.still: High angle from the top of the stairs looking down the full dark staircase. Seth is small, halfway down, mid-tiptoe with one knee lifted high rubber-hose style, and the quilt trails behind him over the steps. Moonlight from screen-left stripes the banister. The green glow waits at the bottom right.
shots.action: He tiptoes down two steps on the beat with high springy knees, bobbing; on 'still' he looks back up over his shoulder into the lens and freezes mid-step.
shots.role: repeats clock tick (the tiptoe keeps the tick)

shots.lyric: The moon is parked on the windowsill,
shots.still: Medium three-quarter at eye level in the narrow hallway. Seth stands at screen-left beside a tall four-pane window. A big round moon rests on the windowsill, and its pale light falls across him from screen-left. His body is turned toward screen-right, the quilt is on his shoulders, and one finger is raised to his lips. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: He presses a finger to his lips toward the moon in a conspiratorial shush; then he turns to the right, looks into the lens and gives a small sly smile.
shots.role: sets up muted trumpet (the window, empty)

shots.lyric: I tiptoe down in my stocking feet
shots.still: Low angle from floor level in the dark hallway. Seth is mid-sneak, stretched tall and thin in cartoon squash-and-stretch, on the toes of his grey wool socks. The quilt drags along the floorboards. Moonlight comes from the window at screen-left, and the green glow from the doorway at screen-right.
shots.action: Long rubber-hose tiptoe strides toward screen-right, his whole body stretching up on each step and squashing down on the beat; on 'feet' he glances down at the lens.
shots.role: escalates clock tick (the walk becomes a dance)

shots.lyric: To the little closet where the servers sleep.
shots.still: Medium eye-level view of Seth at the right end of the hallway, peeking round a small wooden door that stands a hand's width open. A bright vertical stripe of green light falls through the gap across one of his eyes and his moustache. The quilt is on his shoulders and moonlight is on his back from screen-left. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: He eases the door wider with one hand and the green stripe widens across his face; on 'sleep' he turns his lit eye into the lens and lays his cheek on his folded hands like a pillow.
shots.role: escalates celesta twinkles (a stripe of light)

shots.lyric: A hundred lights in a row of green,
shots.still: Wide eye-level view inside a small closet. Tall black server racks fill the right two-thirds of the frame, covered in rows of tiny glowing green and blue dots. Seth stands small in the doorway at screen-left, quilt on his shoulders, arms half-raised in wonder, his whole body lit green. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading, deep shadow at the ceiling.
shots.action: His arms open wide in wonder as the rows of lights blink in a ripple; he takes one step in toward screen-right and rises onto his toes.
shots.role: escalates celesta twinkles (the full rack revealed)

shots.lyric: The softest sound that I've ever seen,
shots.still: Close, eye level: Seth's face lit green from screen-right, tiny points of green light reflected in both eyes. One hand is cupped behind his ear, turned toward the racks at screen-right. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: He listens with the cupped hand at his ear, then slides the cupped hand round in front of his eye like a little telescope; on 'seen' he looks into the lens through it and holds the open vowel.
shots.role: repeats celesta twinkles (lights in his eyes)

shots.lyric: They blink at me like the stars came in
shots.still: Straight-down top shot of the small closet floor. Seth stands in the middle with his face tipped up toward the camera, and the patchwork quilt spreads out round his shoulders in a circle. The racks frame him on every side, their rows of green and blue dots scattered like a field of stars. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: He gazes straight up into the lens and blinks slowly, in time with the lights around him; he turns once on the spot toward screen-right and the quilt fans out.
shots.role: escalates celesta twinkles (the lights become the stars)

shots.lyric: To keep me company again.
shots.still: Medium three-quarter at eye level: Seth faces the green-lit racks at screen-right, quilt on his shoulders, raising one hand in a small shy wave as if greeting old friends. Moonlight from the hallway touches his back from screen-left. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: He waves shyly at the racks with a little wiggle of the fingers, then looks back over his shoulder into the lens with a bashful grin on 'again'.
shots.role: sets up the machines as company

shots.lyric: Hum me a lullaby, little machine,
shots.still: Close, low three-quarter angle from the rack's side at screen-right, looking up at Seth's face. He is brightly lit green, awake and tender, one hand resting flat on the front of the rack at the edge of the frame like on a piano lid. The quilt is at his shoulders. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading, blue and green dots soft in the foreground.
shots.action: He sings straight into the lens; his head sways gently side to side on the beat; on 'machine' his fingers tap the rack front once like a key.
shots.role: sets up chorus framing

shots.lyric: Blink me to sleep in your blue and your green,
shots.still: Medium eye-level side view: Seth in front of the racks at screen-right, one index finger raised like a conductor's baton toward the rows of green and blue dots. The quilt hangs from his shoulders. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: His finger beats time in small arcs and the rows of lights blink on each stroke; on 'green' he turns his face into the lens and holds the baton up.
shots.role: escalates celesta twinkles (he plays the lights like an instrument)

shots.lyric: Nobody's paging and nothing is down,
shots.still: Wide profile view down the narrow aisle of the closet: racks glowing green at screen-right, the doorway and a slice of moonlit hallway at screen-left. Seth is mid-turn with arms out and the quilt flaring round him like a skirt. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: He does one lazy waltz turn toward screen-right with the quilt swirling out, bobbing on the beat, and ends facing the lens with his arms open and easy.
shots.role: repeats electric hum (the quilt moves with the room)

shots.lyric: Just you and me in the quietest town.
shots.still: Medium view of the four-pane hallway window at night, looking out from inside. A big round moon rests at the left of the sill. Just above the outside sill peek the top of a bucket hat and two white oval eyes in the shadow under its brim: Wilson, the living picket fence, half-hidden. Moonlight from screen-left. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: The white oval eyes blink once, slowly; then the bucket hat sinks down below the sill and out of sight.
shots.role: escalates muted trumpet (the window is not empty)

shots.lyric: Hum me a lullaby, sing me a byte,
shots.still: Close, low three-quarter angle from the rack's side at screen-right, the same view as the first chorus but nearer. Seth's cheek almost touches the rack front, his eyelids are heavy, rows of tiny green and blue dots are reflected in his eyes, and the quilt is pulled up to his chin. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: He sings into the lens with drowsy half-closed eyes; his head drifts slowly down toward the rack on the beat; on 'byte' he gives a slow sleepy smile.
shots.role: escalates chorus framing (closer, drowsier)

shots.lyric: Everything's running, and running all right.
shots.still: Medium eye-level three-quarter: Seth stands by the glowing racks at screen-right, giving them a sleepy thumbs-up with one hand, quilt slipping off one shoulder. Moonlight from screen-left on his back. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: He holds the thumbs-up toward the racks; on 'all right' his mouth stretches into an enormous rubber-hose yawn that squashes his whole face, then he blinks into the lens.
shots.role: sets up sleep taking hold

shots.lyric: The fans go round like a gentle sea,
shots.still: Wide profile view of the closet aisle: Seth stands with his eyes closed, swaying, the quilt billowing out behind him and his long wavy hair lifting in a warm breeze from the racks at screen-right. The doorway and moonlit hallway are at screen-left. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: His whole body rocks slowly left and right like a boat on a swell, the quilt rising and falling with each sway, always leaning back toward the racks.
shots.role: escalates electric hum (the room breathes him)

shots.lyric: The disks are whispering back to me,
shots.still: Close profile at eye level: Seth's ear and cheek pressed flat against the front of a glowing rack at screen-right, his eyes closed, a contented smile under his handlebar moustache, green dots glowing beside his face. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: He listens with his ear to the rack and his smile widens; on 'me' his eyes open and slide to the lens without lifting his head.
shots.role: repeats electric hum

shots.lyric: I pull a chair and I rest my head
shots.still: Medium eye-level three-quarter: Seth, quilt round his shoulders, pulls a small wooden kitchen chair across the closet floor toward the glowing racks at screen-right. Moonlight from screen-left. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: He drags the chair to the rack with a springy rubber-hose tug on the beat, then drops onto it with a soft bounce and looks into the lens.
shots.role: sets up the bed he makes of the rack

shots.lyric: On the warmest rack that was ever made.
shots.still: Close, eye level: Seth's head lies sideways on his folded arms on top of a glowing server rack like a pillow, one arm hugging the rack's edge, green and blue dots glowing beside his cheek, his eyelids nearly shut. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: He nuzzles his cheek into his arms on the rack and hugs it closer; on 'made' he sings the held note softly into the lens and his eyes close.
shots.role: escalates chorus framing (his head reaches the rack)

shots.lyric: Go on up to bed now, son,
shots.still: Wide view out through the four-pane hallway window at night: Wilson, a living picket fence in a bucket hat, stands in the moonlit yard outside, with white oval eyes in the shadow under the brim and white-gloved hands. He holds an old tin oil lantern up in his screen-left hand, its glow joining the moonlight from the left. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: He lifts the lantern a little higher and tilts his bucket hat in a slow, kind nod on 'son'; his free white glove points gently upward, toward the stairs.
shots.role: escalates muted trumpet (Wilson in full)

shots.lyric: it'll keep till the morning sun.
shots.still: Close, eye level through one pane of the window glass: Wilson's bucket-hat brim and white oval eyes, warm lantern glow from screen-left, one white-gloved fingertip resting on the glass. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: His white eyes soften into gentle crescents; he taps the glass once, very softly, with his fingertip; then he looks straight into the lens.
shots.role: escalates muted trumpet

shots.lyric: (strings swell, celesta)
shots.still: Medium view from high at screen-left, as if from the window: Seth slumps on the small wooden chair, his head on his arms on the glowing rack at screen-right, the quilt sliding off his shoulders. Moonlight lays a pale window shape across his back. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: He lifts his head halfway and glances sleepily toward the window at screen-left; his head nods slowly once, twice, like a slowing pendulum, and settles back onto the rack to the right.
shots.role: escalates clock tick (the pendulum runs down)

shots.lyric: Oh, but who would watch them through the night,
shots.still: Close, low three-quarter angle from the rack's side at screen-right, the chorus view at its nearest: Seth's head rests sideways on the rack top, eyes almost closed, green and blue dots glowing right against his cheek and moustache, the quilt bunched under his chin. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: Without lifting his head he sings one last time into the lens through barely open eyes; on 'night' he holds the open vowel and his eyes drift shut.
shots.role: escalates chorus framing (pays it off)

shots.lyric: Who would tuck in every little light?
shots.still: Wide eye-level view of the closet: Seth, half asleep in the small wooden chair, draws the patchwork quilt off his shoulders and over the top of the glowing rack at screen-right. Green and blue dots glow softly through the patchwork. Moonlight from the doorway at screen-left. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: He smooths the quilt over the rack like tucking in a child, then lays his cheek down on it and is still.
shots.role: escalates the quilt (prop pays off)

shots.lyric: (choir hum to silence)
shots.still: Close, straight-on, eye level: Wilson's face through the moonlit window pane, his bucket-hat brim and two calm white oval eyes in its shadow. The lantern is lowered and glowing softly at screen-left, and a faint green reflection from the closet sits in the glass. Quiet, still portrait. Warm sepia ink, halftone shading.
shots.action: He holds still and keeps watch, eyes steady on the lens; one slow blink, then he does not move.
shots.role: pays off muted trumpet (the answer to 'who would watch'), still portrait
